thread.topic: Application for Test Admin | MiniGame Server

posts.subject: Application for Test Admin | MiniGame Server
posts.bodyHtml:
SORRY FOR BAD TAGGING, THERE IS NO TAG "APPLICATION MINIGAME".
Hello, i'd like to be an admin on your servers!
I dont fill all requirements but i think i will be really good.
1) What is your name? Real & Ingame - My real name is Gabriel, my nickname is Radiden.
2) How old are you? - Im 12. My birthday was in this year.
3) Why do you want to join our administrative team? - Because your server is one of the best. But unfortunately there are some Griefers, Trolls, Mic Spammers and bullies*. And i just LOVE administrating servers, really. I have more fun administrating the server and helping other people than playing! 😄 And i want to help the server because low activity of other admins.
4) How long have you been playing on our servers? - I was playing here for 33 Hours and 20 Minutes. And i will play on your servers much more, because there's low amount of servers with REAL Minigames. I dont like the Course minigames. And your server is GUT 🙂 !
5) What are your favourite hobbies or pastimes? - I like to watch gameplays and anime. And aswell i like to play csgo! My interests are:
- Programing, virtual security,
- Animals.
In free time i like to:
- Cycle,
- Talk with friends.
Shorter i just like to Meet friends, and interest in computers.
6) Do you think of yourself as mature? - Yes. I almost only have friends older than me, i love to have a good talk about something important, and i love talking. I can speak with slang words and with normal ones. If someone wants a mature conversation - no problem. Even my first internet friends were 14-16 years old 🙂 .
7) Have you gained experience as an administrator before? - A lot of expirience. I was an admin in CS:S Minigame server (it doesn't exist anymore) and im still an Admin on an Garry's Mod server (It's unfortunately dying 🙁 ) and im an moderator on one server in the same game.
[8)] When do you play? (timetable of your average week) - I play like 20 - 30 hours in one week. And like 10 - 15 hours on your server. Everyday i play like 3 - 6 hours daily. 2 - 3 hours on your server.
9) User 1 calls user 2 a "cunt" and proceeds to insult him further - what actions would you take? - First i will warn user 1. If user 1 will continue to bully* him i will kick him. If he will bully* me and the user i would ban him for 24 hours (admin + user insulting) and 2 hours (user insulting). When he comes back and does the same thing again - Perm.
10) Strengths:
- Helping people in everything,
- Talking with someone exotic.
11) Weaknesses:
- Russian who hate me and i cant even understand what is he saying.
- Cruelity, especially animal cruelity
12) Conclusion / Closing remark - I just really would like to be an admin on your servers and help. I hope you will accept me! 🙂


About me: Im just really an nice teenager, from Poland, who likes to play games and talk in English. I am just other. I went mature too fast.


*bullying - Insulting (for me)


Sincerely,
Gabriel "Radiden" Palka.

Hello Radiden,


first off nice to meet you, especially in a forum of a mainly german community.


Usually its important to furfill the activity on the forum and on the Teamspeak, but that is something i shouldn't decide since im only here to tell you my opinion. I will do a + and - List.


+ Server activity
+ Knowledge as an admin
+ You can deal with cruelty and bullying
+ Speaking English / Polish (Polish is good because alot of polish people are also on the servers and it could help in one or another way.
- Age (min. age 16)
- Activity in all forms of the community including: Teamspeak and the Forums.
- Application
- Equipment: Do you own a headset and is your english in anyway flewless?


- These all are things which i can only high recommend for the next application you write, also the Stamm points on the server'(s) which you play on ( you can find your stamm points on the server with the command: !Stamm).



Sidenote: We all are people who just want to play games, i appreciate that you see yourself in a high permission rank, but i personally feel that your age is weird in one or another way.
Since we made experiments with 14-16 Year old Teenager who also wanted to be admin and i got to be honest it didn't work quite well.
Still i don't want to say that you are a bad person and i feel that you got alot of good personalitys.
If you are up to it and really want it we can have a little conversation on wednesday the 24:06.2015 at around 18:00 o'clock (6pm) and we can talk a bit about the application and just about a few others things to check how good your english etc. is.


Otherwise i wish you best of luck and since i don't know you too well i would give you a "NO"
in the first way.


Best wishes: LeDooDNiginz | Chris

Actually I have to admit your application is, although you are from Poland and 12, really good! Unfortunately you just became 12 I think that's waaaaaaay to young.
And to be honest you can't expect us to accept someone who's 12 not meant to be rude but that's how rules work. Also Ithink your weakness aren't really telling us anything about you. You lack on activity in ts and the forum
I know you just want to help the community but maybe gather some activity and become older.


Sincerely soru

You put a lot of afford in your application and for a person, who does not speak English fluently, you did a great application.
Usually expections are made, when somebody tries to become an admin when he/she is 15 or very close to 16.
12 is very young, though you seem to be somebody who would do the job right.
At a certain point, you can not take admins serious when they are too young.
I am sorry, but I'd give you a No.

Hey Radiden,


As some members already said you unfortunately do not meet the requirments to become an administrator.
We do indeed make exceptions at certain applications but usually only when the applicant is age 14-15 as Zescht already mentioned.


Although your apply looks relatively good we simply cannot be sure how mature and qualified a person is at this young age.


Therefore your application is hereby declined.



Sincerely


BlackFire
